findings.headline: Pick the onClick handler inside a function instead of when the element is created.
findings.why: This expression runs once, when the element is created, in Solid 1.x and in Solid 2.0.3 alike. If it reads a signal, store or prop, Solid 2.0.3 dev builds warn STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED, because the handler will not follow later changes.
findings.guidance: If the expression reads reactive state and the handler should follow it, move the read into the handler: onClick={(event) => (selected() ? save : cancel)(event)}. If it only reads constants, nothing changes and this can be left.
